metadata.title: महाराष्ट्र के जंगलों से ख़ास रेसिपी | How  Maharashtra  Tribal Cook Country Chicken | Old Recipes
metadata.description:
In Dahanu, Maharashtra, lives the Warli Adivasi community—a hardworking, humble, and deeply connected community to their traditions. In these villages, you can still find age-old culinary practices being preserved with pride.
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we got a chance to experience one such traditional recipe. A local Warli family prepared a special country chicken dish for us, cooked uniquely with suran (elephant foot yam) and raw mango.
Watch this special presentation to explore the authentic flavours and rich food heritage of the Warli Adivasi community.
